senses.gloss: रो॑च् ind. (√ 1. रुच्) used in a partic. formula, MaitrS.
रोच॑ mfn. shining, radiant, AV.
one who lightens or makes bright, MW.
रोच॑ m. N. of a king, Buddh.
रोची (ई), f. Hingtsha Repens, L.
रोची See under रोच॑.
रोचि f. light, a beam, ray, Hariv.; MārkP.
रोचक mfn. brightening, enlightening, W.
giving an appetite, Suśr.
pleasing, agreeable, W.
रोचक m. a worker in glass or artificial ornaments, R.
(only L.) hunger, appetite
a stomachic or stimulant
a sack
Musa Sapientum
a kind of onion
= ग्रन्थि-पर्ण-भेद.
रोचकिन् mfn. having desire or appetite, taking delight in (loc.), Bālar. (cf. अ-रोच्˚).
रोचन॑ mf(ई or आ)n. bright, shining, radiant, AV.; Br.; GṛS.; MBh.; Hariv.
giving pleasure or satisfaction, pleasant, charming, lovely, Bhaṭṭ.; BhP.
sharpening or stimulating the appetite, stomachic, Suśr.
रोचन॑ m. N. of various plants (Andersonia Rohitika; Alangium Hexapetalum; the pomegranate tree &c.), L.
a partic. yellow pigment (v.l. for रोचना), MBh. (C.)
a stomachic, W.
N. of a demon presiding over a partic. disease, Hariv.
of one of the 5 arrows of the god of love (‘exciter’), Cat.
of a son of Viṣṇu by Dakṣiṇā, BhP.
of Indra under Manu Svārociṣa, ib.
of one of the Viśve Devāḥ, VP.
of a mountain, MārkP.
रोचन॑ f(आ॑) and (ई). See below
रोचन॑ n. light, brightness, (esp.) the bright sky, firmament, luminous sphere (of which there are said to be three; cf. under रजस्), RV.; AV.; Br. (in this sense sometimes f(आ). )
रोचन॑ n. pl. lights, stars, AV.
(ifc.) the causing a desire for, BhP.
(णुचि-रुचे र्˚) N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
1. रोचना॑ f. the bright sky or luminous sphere (= रोचन, m.), AV.; TBr.
a partic. yellow pigment (commonly called गो-रोचना), Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh.; Suśr.
a handsome woman, L.
a red lotus-flower, L.
bamboo manna or Tabāṣīr, L.
dark Śālmali, L.
N. of a wife of Vasu-deva, BhP.
of a Surāṅganā, Siṃhās.
2. रोचना ind. (in रोचना-√ कृ ind.p. -कृत्वा or -कृत्य) g. साक्षाद्-आदि.
रोचन—फल m. the citron tree, L.
रोचन—फला (आ), f. a species of cucumber, L.
रोचन—स्था॑ mfn. abiding in light or in the firmament, RV.
रोचनक m. the citron tree, L.
रोचनिका f. N. of various plants, L.
= वंश-रोचना, bamboo manna or Tabāṣir, L.
रोचना—मुख m. N. of a Daitya, MBh.
रोचना॑—वत् (रोचना॑-, Padap. ˚न॑-) mfn. shining, bright, AV.
रोचनी f. a partic. yellow pigment (= 1. रोचना), Pañcat. (v.l.)
red arsenic, realgar, L.
N. of various plants (Convolvulus Turpethum; the myrobalan tree; Croton Polyandrum; = काम्पिल्ल), L.
(with Buddhists) N. of one of the four Devīs, Dharmas.
रो॑चमान mfn. shining, bright, splendid, RV. &c. &c.
pleasing, agreeable, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
रो॑चमान m. a tuft or curl of hair on a horse's neck, Śiś.; Kathās.
N. of a king, MBh.
रो॑चमाना (आ), f. N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda, ib.
रो॑चस् n. light, lustre, MaitrS. (cf. स्व॑-र्˚).
रोचिन् See मित-र्˚.
रोचिष m. (fr. रोचिस्) N. of a son of Vibhāvasu by Uṣas, BhP.
रोचिष्णु॑ mfn. shining, bright, brilliant, splendid, gay, VS. &c. &c.
giving an appetite, stomachic, Suśr.
रोचिष्णु—मुख mfn. having a bright countenance, MW.
रोचिष्-मत् mfn. (fr. रोचिस् + मत्) possessing or giving light, Hariv.
रोचिष्-मत् m. N. of a son of Manu Svārociṣa, BhP.
रोचि॑स् n. light, lustre, brightness, RV. &c. &c.
grace, loveliness, BhP.
रो॑चुक mfn. causing pleasure or delight, MaitrS. (cf. अरोचुक॑).
रोच्य᳙ mfn. used in a partic. formula, MaitrS. (cf. रो॑च्).
